```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

install.packages("countrycode")

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(countrycode)

#load data
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2026-06-02')

eplp <- tuesdata$eplp
```

I wanted to be able to compare across countries, so I combined variables for mandatory maternity leave before and after birth, voluntary maternity leave after birth, co-parent leave, job-protected leave for mothers & co-parents, and paid parental leave to create a 'generosity of parental leave' score.

```{r}
parental_leave <- eplp %>%
    mutate(
        #create a score for generosity of parental leave
        generosity_index = (
            mat_m_ld_bb + mat_m_ld_ab +
                mat_v_ld_ab +
                co_ld +
                par1_ld + 
                par2_ld + 
                par3_ld +
                (jp_ld_m + jp_ld_co) / 2
        ) / 8,
        country_name = countrycode::countrycode(country, 'iso2c', 'country.name')
        ) %>%
arrange(desc(generosity_index)) %>%
    group_by(country) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

heatmap_data <- eplp %>%
  mutate(
    generosity_index = (
      mat_m_ld_bb + mat_m_ld_ab + 
      mat_v_ld_ab +
      co_ld +
      par1_ld +
      par2_ld + 
      par3_ld +
      (jp_ld_m + jp_ld_co) / 2
    ) / 8,
    country_name = countrycode::countrycode(country, 'iso2c', 'country.name')
  ) %>%
  select(country, country_name, year, generosity_index) %>%
  drop_na()

# Plot 1: Basic heatmap with country names
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = year, y = reorder(country_name, generosity_index, FUN = median), fill = generosity_index)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027", 
    mid = "#fee08b", 
    high = "#1a9850",
    name = "Generosity\nIndex\n(days)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "European Parental Leave Generosity Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Country",
    subtitle = "Combined metric: mandatory + voluntary + paid parental + job-protected leave"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Plot 2: 2015-2024 with greater detail
recent_years <- heatmap_data %>%
  filter(year >= 2015)  

ggplot(recent_years, aes(x = factor(year), y = reorder(country_name, generosity_index, FUN = median), fill = generosity_index)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(generosity_index, 0)), size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027", 
    mid = "#fee08b", 
    high = "#1a9850",
    name = "Generosity\nIndex"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "European Parental Leave Generosity: Recent Trends (2015-2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

```
